lines.en: Crawling slowly along the sand dune
Waves crash as I swim by
Leaving marks in the sand
Passing through salt algae filled waters
Seeking salty food
Sand reveals my form
Adapting to salty water
Moving quickly in the sand
Foraging under salt algae
Navigating through tides

lines.zh: 八条腿踩过盐粒，沙沙响。
lines.en: Eight legs crunch over salt grains.

lines.zh: 壳上结着盐霜，走一路掉一路。
lines.en: Salt frost on my shell falls with each step.

lines.zh: 我横着走过盐湖的浅滩。
lines.en: I sidle across the salt lake's shallows.

lines.zh: 两只螯举在身前，像举着刀。
lines.en: Both claws held forward like blades.

lines.zh: 我钻进盐堆，只留一根触须。
lines.en: I burrow into the salt heap, one antenna out.

lines.zh: 潮水退时，我跟着往深处走。
lines.en: As the tide falls, I follow it deeper.
Buried quietly in the sand
Enjoying the embrace of the sea
Observing the surroundings
Rolling leisurely in the sand

lines.zh: 盐粒盖住背，我只露螯尖。
lines.en: Salt covers my back; only my claw tips show.

lines.zh: 潮水退了，我慢慢吐泡泡。
lines.en: The tide withdraws; I blow slow bubbles.
Slowly wriggling
Emerging slightly from the sand
Observing the player
Sleeping briefly in the sand

lines.zh: 我把自己埋进盐里，只露眼睛。
lines.en: I bury myself in salt with only my eyes out.
Sea salt crystallizes in my shell's seams.

lines.zh: 我举着螯，等一只小鱼经过。
lines.en: Claws raised, I wait for a small fish.

lines.zh: 盐湖的水一动，我就缩回去。
lines.en: The salt lake stirs and I pull back in.
Showing curious eyes at the player
Staring at the player's back
Tracing the player's path

lines.zh: 我举着螯，盐粒从壳上掉。
lines.en: Raising my claws; salt grains fall off my shell.
As you come near, I shrink into the salt.
Noticing the player's figure
Examining the player curiously
Focusing on the player

lines.zh: 我从盐堆里抬起一只眼。
lines.en: I lift one eye from the salt pile.

lines.zh: 我的螯举到一半，停住了。
lines.en: My claw rises halfway and stops.
My shell is broken!
Salt crusts my shell; do not lick it.
Too salty for me...
I need brine...
Too cold...
Hit a rock...
Too salty...
Running out of breath...
A seam just cracked in my shell.

lines.zh: 壳裂了一道，盐流进伤口。
lines.en: My shell split and salt runs into the wound.
Shell hard as stone, can't resist the bait.
Crawls in sand, waits for fish bait.
Slides through seaweed, feeds without care.
Swims in brackish water, craves the taste.
Feeds with feelers, tastes delightful.
Wanders in sand, hunts prey.
More active at nightfall.
Salt draws, follows closely.
Shell conceals, life spawns.
Hear footsteps, ready to strike.
Collides with rocks, panics and flees.
Feelers touched, quickly retreat.
Collides with coral, avoids danger.
Collides with beach, escapes to deep sea.
Antennae collide, quickly avoid.
Collides underwater, quickly escapes.
Corals touched, retreats.
Collides with sand, dives deeper.
Tentacles touch, quickly dodge.

lines.zh: 你踢开了我藏身的盐堆。
lines.en: You kicked apart the salt heap I hid in.
Call to mate, attracts partner.
Feelers brush, mate meet.
Sand lightly shaken, mate signal.
Feelers gently touch, mate recognized.
Mating call, with wave sound.
Feelers lightly touched, mate found.
Lightly hop on sand, mating dance.
Tentacles gently touch, mate joined.
Sand mating, calls answer.
Feelers gently touch, mating done.

lines.zh: 咔嚓一声，盐蟹壳裂开，露出里面的小盐蟹。
lines.en: A crackle, and the salt crab shell splits to reveal a baby.

lines.zh: 盐蟹挥动着触须，似乎在寻找美味。
lines.en: The salt crab waves its antennae, searching for food.

lines.zh: 盐蟹用尖锐的螯夹住了一块小石头。
lines.en: The salt crab clamps a small stone with its pincers.

lines.zh: 盐蟹的外壳上覆盖着一层厚厚的盐霜。
lines.en: A thick layer of salt covers the salt crab's shell.

lines.zh: 盐蟹在沙子中挖了一个小坑，似乎要产卵。
lines.en: The salt crab digs a small hole in the sand to lay its eggs.

lines.zh: 盐蟹用螯轻轻拍打着水面，激起一圈圈涟漪。
lines.en: The salt crab gently taps the water with its pincers, creating ripples.

lines.zh: 盐蟹从沙子里探出头，四处张望。
lines.en: The salt crab pokes its head out of the sand, looking around.

lines.zh: 盐蟹用螯夹起一片海藻，享受着美味。
lines.en: The salt crab picks up a piece of seaweed and savors it.

lines.zh: 盐蟹的触须在水中游动，寻找食物。
lines.en: The salt crab's antennae swim in the water, searching for food.

lines.zh: 盐蟹在沙子中迅速移动，寻找新的栖息地。
lines.en: The salt crab quickly moves through the sand, searching for a new home.

lines.zh: 盐蟹的螯瞄准了一个小鱼。
lines.en: The salt crab's pincers aim at a small fish.

lines.zh: 盐蟹悄悄接近，准备捕捉目标。
lines.en: The salt crab approaches quietly, ready to capture its target.

lines.zh: 盐蟹露出水面，准备攻击。
lines.en: The salt crab breaks the surface, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 盐蟹张开螯，准备夹住目标。
lines.en: The salt crab opens its pincers, ready to grab its target.

lines.zh: 盐蟹突然跳起，捕捉到一只小虾。
lines.en: The salt crab jumps, catching a small shrimp.

lines.zh: 盐蟹的螯锁定了一只小鱼。
lines.en: The salt crab's pincers lock onto a small fish.

lines.zh: 盐蟹悄无声息地接近目标。
lines.en: The salt crab moves silently towards its target.

lines.zh: 盐蟹用螯夹住了一只小鱼。
lines.en: The salt crab clamps a small fish with its pincers.

lines.zh: 盐蟹迅速将目标拖入沙中。
lines.en: The salt crab quickly drags its target into the sand.

lines.zh: 盐蟹用螯夹住目标，准备进食。
lines.en: The salt crab clamps its target with its pincers, ready to eat.

lines.zh: 盐蟹的触须不断触碰周围的物体。
lines.en: The salt crab's antennae touch nearby objects.

lines.zh: 盐蟹用螯夹住沙子，稳固身体。
lines.en: The salt crab clamps the sand with its pincers to steady itself.

lines.zh: 我用螯试了试你的鞋跟。
lines.en: I test your heel with one claw.

lines.zh: 盐蟹小心翼翼地靠近目标。
lines.en: The salt crab cautiously approaches its target.

lines.zh: 盐蟹的触须感觉到了目标的存在。
lines.en: The salt crab's antennae detect the presence of its target.

lines.zh: 盐蟹用螯夹住小鱼，准备拖走。
lines.en: The salt crab clamps a small fish with its pincers, ready to carry it away.

lines.zh: 盐蟹用螯夹住一块石头，拖动它。
lines.en: The salt crab clamps a stone with its pincers, dragging it.

lines.zh: 盐蟹小心翼翼地探索周围环境。
lines.en: The salt crab cautiously explores its surroundings.

lines.zh: 盐蟹用螯夹住小虾，准备进食。
lines.en: The salt crab clamps a small shrimp with its pincers, ready to eat.

lines.zh: 触须一碰，就知道你有多硬。
lines.en: One touch of an antenna tells me how hard you are.

lines.zh: 咔嚓！它张牙舞爪地向你扑来。
lines.en: Crunch! It lunges at you with its claws.

lines.zh: 盐浪中，它猛然冲向你的身体。
lines.en: In the salt waves, it lunges at your body.

lines.zh: 它的螯夹紧了，咔嚓一声。
lines.en: Its claws clamp down, crunching.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶声中，它狠狠地撞击你。
lines.en: With a hiss, it ram you hard.
It viciously bites at your hand.

lines.zh: 你感觉到它的螯狠狠抓你。
lines.en: You feel its claws grab you harshly.

lines.zh: 它的螯尖刺入你的皮肤。
lines.en: Its claw tips pierce your skin.
You are rammed back a few steps.
It clamps its claws on your arm.

lines.zh: 它的螯狠狠咬向你的肉。
lines.en: Its claws bite into your flesh harshly.

lines.zh: 在天境的盐湖中，它突然出现。
lines.en: In the salt lakes of the sky, it suddenly appears.

lines.zh: 天境里，它从盐堆中冒出来。
lines.en: From a pile of salt, it pops up in the sky.

lines.zh: 盐湖中，它从海底冒出来。
lines.en: It pops up from the salt lake.

lines.zh: 它从天境的岩层中爬出来。
lines.en: It crawls out of the sky rock.

lines.zh: 天境里，它从沙堆中冒出来。
lines.en: From a pile of sand, it pops up in the sky.

lines.zh: 它从天境的盐堆中出现。
lines.en: It appears from a pile of salt in the sky.
It emerges from the sea in the sky.

lines.zh: 它从天境的岩层中钻出来。
lines.en: It drills out of the sky rock.

lines.zh: 在天境的盐湖中，它游了出来。
lines.en: In the salt lake of the sky, it swims out.

lines.zh: 天境的盐堆中，它慢慢爬出来。
lines.en: From a pile of salt in the sky, it slowly crawls out.
Water! Water!
Fall into sea...

lines.zh: 盐水灌进鳃里，我快憋不住了。
lines.en: Salt water floods my gills; I can't hold.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我和盐壳一起掀翻。
lines.en: The blast flips me and the salt crust together.
An arrow punches a hole in my salty shell.
Magic hit...

lines.zh: 盐湖里没吃的，螯都软了。
lines.en: No food in the salt lake; my claws go soft.
Lightning strike...

lines.zh: 虚空里没有盐，我干瘪下去。
lines.en: No salt in the void; I shrivel.
